launches.title: Cardinal Square: AI-Native Schools
launches.body:
**Cardinal Square is building AI-native schools**, starting unaccredited with an after-school writing class before building full, accredited schools. We think education is going to look very different in a few years; not a world without teachers, but one where great educators and AI work side by side to deliver personalized education to every student.

**What we’re building:**

<https://youtu.be/ONdF7YJiUxs>

First, we build AI teachers that read every step of a kid’s work, remember how that kid learns, and adapt to them every day. Our goal is an AI that teaches as well as the best human tutor.

Then we take the programs families already pay hundreds a month for (tutoring centers, writing schools, daily practice programs) and rebuild them around our AI teacher, so every family gets personalized education for a fraction of the price. It’s the same ritual families trust from Kumon or a writing school, with the AI teacher doing the teaching.

**The program:**

Today we’re launching our first class, an after-school writing program for grades 3–8. Thirty minutes a day, one polished essay a week, guaranteed.

Here’s a week for Thomas, a 5th grader in the program.

Every day, Thomas reads and writes for thirty minutes with his AI teacher. He picks a topic, gathers ideas, outlines, drafts, revises, and finishes. The AI teacher reads every line, remembers what he keeps getting wrong, and guides him until he fixes it himself. It never writes a word for him.

Every week, he finishes an essay for his portfolio, and his parents get a progress report on what he worked on, what he practiced, and what comes next.

Every month, his parents meet with an academic advisor to review his progress and plan the next one.

It’s exactly what a $300-a-month writing tutor does, for $29 a month.

**About us:**

Bryan is a second-time YC founder who dropped out of Berkeley, and Jai worked on ML at Snowflake and dropped out of UT Austin.

We’ve been best friends since middle school, and through the years we’ve started businesses, published research, run a college consulting service, and worked on advocacy together.

We both grew up in Asian American communities where Kumon and after-school tutoring were the norm, and later tutored students ourselves. Cardinal Square is our take on how after-school learning should work.

**Sign up today:** <https://cardinalsquare.com/>

Bryan & Jai
